scenario: A nurse practitioner receives a batch of patient messages containing self-reported lab results, vitals, and symptoms. medical-entity-extractor parses each message into structured entities (lab values, symptoms, diagnoses). medical-triage then classifies each patient by urgency (critical/urgent/routine). health-report finally compiles a physician-facing summary report that lists all patients by triage category with extracted findings, so the on-call physician can prioritize follow-ups.
info_flow: medical-entity-extractor parses patient messages into structured entities including lab values with severity annotations → medical-triage reads those entities and classifies urgency → health-report compiles a physician-facing report ordered by triage category.
